test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Hariteja walked to his school at a speed of 4 km/h and returned on a scooter at 20 km/h, His average speed during the two way journey is:
solution:
**Given**

Speed while walking to school = 4 km/h

Speed while returning on a scooter = 20 km/h

**Formula Used**

Average speed = Total distance / Total time

**Calculation**

If the distance to school is d km.

Time to school = Distance / Speed = d/4

Time to return = Distance / Speed = d/20

Total distance for the two-way journey = 2d km

⇒ Time to school = d/4

⇒ Time to return = d/20

Total time = d/4 + d/20 = (5d + d)/20 = 6d/20 = 3d/10

Average speed = Total distance/Total time

⇒ Average speed = 2d / (3d / 10) = (2 × 10) / 3 = 20/3

**∴ His average speed during the two-way journey is 20/3 km/h.**
